about.title: About ARIA
about.description: ARIA orders vendors for human review with the IPS (priority indicator): it adds the risk indicator or the Mahalanobis distance of its most unusual contract, an earlier model (v5.2), the money scale and external records (RUBLI cases, EFOS, SFP). Six patterns run in production; P5 (amount out of range) is not computed.
about.disclaimer: IPS scores are risk indicators, not corruption verdicts. High scores indicate statistical similarity to documented corruption patterns and warrant further investigation.

_patterns_source: patterns.P1–P7 = backend/api/public_labels.py PATTERN_LABELS (the public-label canon, pre-publication audit B4). Change them there first, then here.

methodology.title: How does ARIA work?
methodology.body: ARIA adds four components into the IPS: 0.40 × the larger of the risk indicator and the most unusual contract (Mahalanobis), 0.20 × an earlier model (v5.2), 0.20 × external records and 0.20 × the money scale. It orders the review; it is not a probability.
